content: 1. A new footnote has been added to the guidelines, specifically referencing d as (2-Methyl-4-chlorophenoxy)acetic acid. The guidance levels for this compound were rounded to the nearest order of magnitude. This was achieved by averaging the logarithmic scale values, with adjustments made depending on whether the calculated value was below or above a specific threshold (e.g., 3 × 10^n). 2. The title of Annex 7 in the guidelines has been updated to: Contributors to the development of the Guidelines for Drinking-Water Quality: Fourth Edition incorporating the First Addendum. 3. The introductory sentence of Annex 7 has been replaced with the following: This annex lists the names of individuals who contributed to the development of the fourth edition of the Guidelines for Drinking-Water Quality and its first addendum. Contributions were made through participation in relevant meetings, authorship or peer review of the text in the guidelines or supporting documents, or by providing intellectual advice. 4. The list of contributors has been updated to include a comprehensive roster of experts from various organizations, institutions, and countries. These contributors represent a wide range of expertise in water quality, public health, environmental science, and related fields. Their affiliations include universities, government agencies, international organizations, and private sector entities. 5. The guidelines emphasize the collaborative and multidisciplinary nature of the work, highlighting the global effort to ensure safe drinking water standards.
